item.title: Fruit Tree, 21st September
item.description:
The tree located on the pavement on Bourne Road close to the junction of Haywood Road causes problems every year. The tree produces fruit which in turn falls off of the branches. The fruits are extremely sticky and are squashed all over the pavement causing a health hazard in more ways than one. The fruits are rotten, smelly and causing lots of flies aswell as the pavements becoming very sticky and unsafe. Myself and my neighbour constantly sweep the mess into the road which is failed to be removed by the street team. The tree needs regular maintenance or should be removed. This tree is not suitable for a street in which lots of people walk on. Could somebody please attend ASAP to remove the debris and to assess the need of this tree. Thank you

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Bourne Road, Widmore, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
